settings.content: Catalogue mode. Guests can browse species, sizes and availability — which keeps the catalogue useful and indexable — but pricing, quantity selectors, the add-to-order button and the cart are all hidden until they sign in.

settings.label: Who can see pricing
settings.info: "Approved trade customers" is the safe default: anyone can create an account, so tag-gating is what stops the public seeing wholesale rates.

settings.label: Customer tag that unlocks pricing
settings.info: Used by the "approved trade customers" option. Shopify B2B company contacts are always treated as approved.

settings.label: Gate message
settings.default: Sign in to see your pricing and place orders. Trade accounts are open to registered businesses that resell aquarium livestock.

settings.label: Limited stock below
settings.info: Cards switch to the amber limited-stock state at or under this count.
